name: Haruiro ☆ Communication ♪
original_name: 春色☆こみゅにけ～しょん♪
source:
I'm Haruka. I'm studying hard to become a doctor. It'd be best if I could devote myself to my study, but I was in love with a boy. However, I couldn't understand what he thought! Why was he so popular among girls? Handsome? Well, maybe... One day, he suddenly left school. According to a rumor, he currently stays at a hotel in the country. It's spring vacation now. I've made up my mind to meet him again...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
我叫春香，正在为成为医生而努力学习。如果能够一心投入学业当然最好，但我偏偏爱上了一个男孩。然而，我完全猜不透他的心思！他为什么那么受女孩子欢迎？因为长得帅？嗯，或许吧……某天，他突然离开了学校。据传他目前住在乡下一家旅馆里。现在正值春假，我已经下定决心，要再次去见他……

[摘自ErogeShop]
